summary: Gives best practices for writing specifications that use HTTP as a base for new application protocols. It is mainly meant to guide IETF efforts for protocols deployed on the Internet, though it may suit other situations. It is a Best Current Practice and obsoletes RFC 3205.

eli5.summary: Advice for people designing a new service on top of the web's rules.

questions: best practices for http based apis
when to use http as a substrate
